newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yen to bounce back to 110 yen level to dlr - Toshiba.
newsitem.headline: Yen to bounce back to 110 yen level to dlr - Toshiba.

text.p: Toshiba Corp president Taizo Nishimuro said on Monday that the dollar would likely return to the 110 yen level in the latter half of 1997.

Asked about his outlook on currencies, Nishimuro told reporters, "In the near-term, the yen could weaken to the level of around 125 yen and 130 yen to the dollar, but it would likely be back to the 110 yen level in the latter half of this year."

Nishimuro added that his company kept its internal reference dollar/yen exchange rate at 110 yen despite the recent weakness in the yen for the dollar. The dollar stood at just above 119 yen as of 1040 GMT on Monday.

Asked about recent weakness in Tokyo stock market, he said it was the market's expression of its disappointment that the government is not acting appropriately to speed up deregulation in the economy.
"The market may continue to stay in the doldrums for a while," Nishimuro said.
